stratagems.name: Strength From Death
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after an YNNARI unit from your army is destroyed.
stratagems.target: One other YNNARI unit within 12" of the destroyed unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the battle round, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of models in your unit and your unit gains the Fights First ability.

stratagems.name: Revenant Boon
stratagems.target: One YNNARI unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Roll a D3: your unit regains that many lost wounds, or if your unit has the Wounds characteristic of 1, return that many destroyed models to your unit.

stratagems.name: Soulburst
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after a YNNARI model destroys an enemy model.
stratagems.target: One YNNARI unit from your army within 6" of the enemy model that was destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move, shoot, or fight (as appropriate to the current phase), even if it has already done so this turn.
